import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { editor } from "../../../backend/schema/editor";

export const editorCms = customizeTable<typeof editor>("editor", {
    display: {
        title: "name"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "name", "email", "website", "password", "ha1"],
    fields: {
        bio: {
            multiline: true
        },
        memberSince: {
            readOnly: true
        },
        lastLoginDate: {
            readOnly: true
        },
        lastUpdated: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "website",
        "password",
        "ha1",
        "deleted",
        "privs",
        "gender",
        "memberSince",
        "emailConfirmDate",
        "lastLoginDate",
        "lastUpdated",
        "birthDate",
        "areaRelation",
        "bio"
    ]
});
